scope: All own-directory file leaves existing now, except this self-referential manifest. Selective custody is per leaf; never copy the entire inputs directory by default.
source_and_instruction_policy: Whole raw PDF/HTML/full layouts and process/cache instruction snapshots are reference-only. No private workspace guard, full external-state map, ATLAS or external cache directory is included or newly copied.
failure_receipt_limit: Failure receipts are explicitly transcriptions from actual tool errors; no pre-correction script artifact is invented.
